bio.text: Linda Chaney is a Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 61, first elected in 2020.
According to the House's biographical page, Chaney served as a St. Pete Beach city commissioner from 2007 to 2009 and works in marketing and business development.
Chaney lives in St. Pete Beach, holds a B.S. in mass communications from the University of South Florida, and moved to Florida in 1982.
